sources.fullCitation: Henner Pfau, Lexikon der deutschen Tanzmusik 1925–1945. 10 vols. Uelzen: self-published; from vol. 2 Leverkusen: Pfau, 1987–2018. Vol. 6, (Foxtrott u.ä.) L–Q (2003), p. 780, entry “Mit dir möchte ich ziehn bis zum Ende der Welt”, marked SF: Germany, 1931, music Kaper, Dr. B., words Rotter, Fritz, with the remark “Details unbekannt” and no discs listed. Digitised in the Digitale Bibliothek Thüringen from the copy in the Lippmann + Rau-Musikarchiv.
sources.title: Pfau, Lexikon der deutschen Tanzmusik 1925–1945, vol. 6: (Foxtrott u.ä.) L–Q
sources.creator: Henner Pfau
sources.researchNote: The citation as first recorded named eight volumes dated 1987 and carried the DOI of vol. 1, which covers titles A–C; the set runs to ten volumes published between 1987 and 2018, and the entry stands in vol. 6 of 2003. The entry has now been read in the digitised volume. Pfau lists no records for the song and notes that details are unknown, which is consistent with its absence from the German national bibliography, the discographic title lists and the indexes of printed song collections. A similar but distinct title, “Mit dir möcht' ich geh'n bis an's Ende der Welt”, was composed by J. Pfeil and recorded in 1938.
